description:
Find where a product is cheapest right now. Matches the same product at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores and Lidl and returns each store's current price side by side, with unit prices, offers and member prices (Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards, Lidl Plus). It answers for one product a call. To list the products matched at several stores, leave out query and set min_stores, e.g. min_stores=5 for every product matched at all five. Free: no BasketWatch account needed.

total is how many matched products the search found in all. cheapest_match is the cheapest product of the kind asked for, by shelf price; matches lists the closest matches first, not the cheapest, so the first of them is not the cheapest. In each match, prices is keyed by store; cheapest_store goes by shelf price and cheapest_store_with_card by the loyalty-card price where a shop has one. unit_price is in the shop's own measure (unit_basis); price_per_kg or price_per_litre is the same figure per kilo or per litre. A store missing from "prices" did not have that product in its online range today and may still sell it in store: say "not found online", not that the store lacks it. offer_ends is the last day an offer applies (Irish time): say when an offer ends, as online orders are priced for the delivery or collection day.

limit.description: How many matched products to return (default 5, at most 50).

min_stores.description: Only products matched at this many shops or more, 2 to 5. With no query, lists them: 5 for what all five sell.

query.description: The one product to compare, e.g. 'heinz ketchup' or 'kerrygold butter 454g'. Leave it out only to list what several shops stock (min_stores).

name: compare_prices

product.description: The matched product, as in matches
product.title: Product

store.description: The shop with its lowest shelf price
store.title: Store

cheapest_store_with_card.description: Lowest price for someone holding every shop's loyalty card: clubcard_price where a shop has one, else its shelf price
cheapest_store_with_card.title: Cheapest Store With Card

prices.description: Keyed by store (aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes, lidl); a store missing here did not have this product in its online range today (it may still sell it in store)
prices.title: Prices

left.description: Credits left on the account after it
left.title: Left

note.description: Said when the balance is low, or when it cut this answer short
note.title: Note

used.description: Credits this answer cost: one for each record it returned
used.title: Used

clubcard_price.description: Member price where one applies: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price

name.description: The product as this store lists it
name.title: Name

offer_ends.description: Last day the offer applies, YYYY-MM-DD, Irish time, where the retailer states it
offer_ends.title: Offer Ends

price_per_kg.description: unit_price worked out per kilo, where the shop prices the product by weight: the figure to compare packs of different sizes on (per kilo drained, where unit_basis says drained weight)
price_per_kg.title: Price Per Kg

price_per_litre.description: unit_price worked out per litre, where the shop prices the product by volume
price_per_litre.title: Price Per Litre

unit_basis.description: The measure unit_price is in, as the shop states it: '1 KG', '100g', '75cl', 'each'
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: The shop's own unit price, in the measure unit_basis names: per kg at one shop, per 100g or per 75cl at another, so as it stands it does not compare across rows
unit_price.title: Unit Price

cheapest_match.description: With a query: the cheapest product that is the kind of thing asked for (butter for 'butter', never butter popcorn), by shelf price at any shop. It is one of matches

credits.description: What this answer cost the person's BasketWatch account and what is left. Missing on a free answer

hint.description: What to try, when nothing matched
hint.title: Hint

total.description: How many matched products the search found in all; matches holds the first of them (raise limit for more)
total.title: Total

title: Where is a product cheapest
